label: Public transit departures
description: Scheduled weekly (Mon-Sun) public transit departures per 1,000 residents, computed from UTA's real published GTFS feed (https://gtfsfeed.rideuta.com/GTFS.zip, feed_version 2026 AUG_20261008) by counting stop_times rows at every GTFS stop within 3km of the town centroid, for the representative week of 20260914-20260920, divided by town population and multiplied by 1000. Towns with 0 have no UTA stops within range, i.e. outside UTA's GTFS-covered service area: cedar-city, eagle-mountain, ephraim, heber-city, hurricane, kanab, logan, midway, moab, park-city, price, richfield, saratoga-springs, st-george, vernal, washington. That includes rural southern/eastern Utah towns UTA does not serve at all (moab, vernal, price, richfield, kanab, cedar-city, st-george, hurricane, washington, ephraim), some of which have separate regional systems (e.g. SunTran in Cedar City/St. George) not covered by this feed, plus a few towns just outside UTA's practical reach (park-city, heber-city, midway, logan, eagle-mountain, saratoga-springs) where the nearest GTFS stop is well beyond this radius.
